description: This file defines functions and types for generating GraphQL input types and handling value updates/creation for a component schema in a KeystoneJS project. It manages complex schema types including objects, arrays, conditionals, relationships, and form validation, with support for create/update operations and relationship resolution.

classes.name: RelationshipErrors
classes.description: Custom error class for handling multiple relationship errors during nested mutations.

methods.name: getGraphQLInputType
methods.description: Generates a GraphQL input type based on schema and operation type, with caching.

methods.name: getGraphQLInputTypeInner
methods.description: Recursively constructs GraphQL input types based on schema kind.

methods.name: getValueForUpdate
methods.description: Processes and validates values for updating a component schema, resolving relationships.

methods.name: getValueForCreate
methods.description: Processes and validates values for creating a component schema, resolving relationships.

methods.name: checkUniqueItemExists
methods.description: Checks if a unique item exists in the database for relationship resolution.

methods.name: resolveCreateMutation
methods.description: Performs a create mutation via GraphQL to create a related item.

methods.name: resolveRelateToManyForCreateInput
methods.description: Handles nested create/connect for to-many relationships during creation.

methods.name: resolveRelateToManyForUpdateInput
methods.description: Handles nested create/connect/disconnect/set for to-many relationships during update.

methods.name: resolveRelateToOneForCreateInput
methods.description: Handles nested create/connect for to-one relationships during creation.

methods.name: resolveRelateToOneForUpdateInput
methods.description: Handles connect/create/disconnect for to-one relationships during update.
